correctness.rationale: In odd characteristic, at a two-torsion pair one may use anti-invariant local parameters u,v and the invariant cone with coordinates u²,uv,v². The resolution separates the two coordinate-axis branches into transverse intersections at distinct points of the exceptional conic. Away from those points parallel coordinate curves are disjoint and opposite ones cannot meet. The eight coordinate quotients and sixteen exceptional components are rational; the connected full 1-subdivision of K4,4 gives 24 vertices, 32 nodes and genus 9. Arithmetic and geometric Frobenius are inverse permutations and have the same fixed subgroup; each fixes both identity labels. Independently computed through the cycle lattice: orient each subdivided path from its H-vertex to its V-vertex. The nine fundamental cycles indexed by nonzero (i,j) traverse edges indexed (i,j),(0,0) positively and (i,0),(0,j) negatively, with both halves of each original edge used. Their Gram matrix is 2(I3+J3)⊗(I3+J3), where J3 is all ones. Restriction of the edge lattice to its pairing with cycles identifies its quotient by the integral cut lattice with the dual of the integral cycle lattice; further quotient by cycles gives the graph critical group. The label group permutes this basis, so adjoining P−I to the Gram matrix and taking integer Smith forms gives the coinvariants. The invariant perfect discriminant pairing yields the fixed groups by duality. Recovered all nine rows and the determinant 2^21; these are nine ordered cases, not nine pairwise non-isomorphic groups. In the full-group coinvariants the transitive basis collapses to one generator, with relation 32 by the constant Gram row sum. The separate grounded-potential calculation for H0−C00 gives endpoint potentials 23/32,15/32,9/32,17/32 in the classes H0,Hi,V0,Vj, with each nongrounded subdivision vertex taking the average of its endpoints. The exact denominator and the fixed labels verify that this class generates the full fixed C32.
residual_risks: This is a geometric graph group with a label action. It does not assert existence of an equivariant regular smoothing or identify a Néron component group without additional hypotheses.

value.rationale: The labelled genus-nine dual graph is a natural equivariant arithmetic object. Its ordinary group does not predict which torsion survives each Frobenius action; the table resolves the 2-primary structure, including cases with even action order. The uniform exact-order divisor difference ties the fixed groups together geometrically, identifies the full symmetry-fixed subgroup, and is useful even when the ordinary graph group is already known. The significance is in this equivariant information, not in counting the classical components or restating the matrix-tree order.
residual_risks: The result does not classify smoothings, nonproduct Kummer surfaces, or graph groups in characteristic two.
